title: "About me"

I'm **Nicolas Sousa**, from São Paulo, Brazil.

My background combines professional experience in finance with studies in accounting, engineering, computing, physics and mathematics. I enjoy connecting disciplines and investigating questions that emerge where they meet.

This independent site is a place to write and document how my ideas evolve.

## Interests

- Knowledge representation and epistemology
- Graphs and scientific networks
- Physics and mathematics
- Artificial intelligence and automation
- Tools and learning experiences

Opinions expressed here are personal and do not represent employers or affiliated institutions.
